user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop indexing box that advances an internal platform by one discrete step when rotated via an external hand crank, with the output remaining stationary between steps, all enclosed in a protective housing.
product_intent: A mechanical device that advances an internal platform by discrete steps through manual rotation of an external hand crank while maintaining positional stability between indexing events within a protective housing.

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop indexing box
The user should rotate an external hand crank to advance an internal indexing platform by one discrete step
The output should remain stationary between indexing events
The mechanism should be enclosed inside a protective housing
The number of indexed positions is not prescribed
The product should be mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, practical to manufacture, and suitable for repeated manual operation

requirements.statement: The product shall advance an internal indexing platform by one discrete step when rotated via an external hand crank

verification.observable: internal indexing platform advances by one discrete step when external hand crank is rotated

requirements.statement: The output shall remain stationary between indexing events

verification.observable: output position remains unchanged between indexing events

requirements.statement: The mechanism shall be enclosed inside a protective housing

verification.observable: mechanism is completely enclosed within housing

requirements.statement: The product shall be suitable for manual operation only

verification.observable: product operates via manual hand crank rotation only

requirements.statement: The product shall be mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, practical to manufacture, and suitable for repeated manual operation

verification.observable: product meets mechanical plausibility, ease of assembly, manufacturability and repeated operation requirements

freedoms.subject: number of indexed positions
freedoms.statement: The number of indexed positions is not prescribed

relations.rationale: The indexing mechanism must be designed to hold position between steps
The indexing mechanism must be enclosed within a housing for protection

operating_scenarios.name: Normal operation
operating_scenarios.description: User rotates external hand crank to advance internal platform by one discrete step, with output remaining stationary between indexing events

operating_scenarios.name: Housing containment
operating_scenarios.description: Mechanism is completely enclosed within protective housing during all operations
